description: Attested-provenance replication. The only cryptographic evidence in this profile is a Sigstore/Fulcio/Rekor build-provenance attestation binding executable bytes to a source commit and a workflow identity. That is a statement about bytes at rest, not about an execution: it does not show that a computation ran, on what input, or with what result. It is therefore deliberately absent from accepted_attestation_formats, which names run-evidence formats only, and that list is empty. Execution confidence comes solely from k independent replicas agreeing on a Merkle root, which is an operational-independence argument rather than a hardware one. The evidence class is local_unattested and production_hardware_evidence is false. This profile is not admissible as a production trusted-compute receipt and has no path to the Lean accepted-run axiom.
